# About

Hi everyone.

I am Nick Anderson, a PhD candidate in Economics at The New School for Social
Research. This is a website where I host my projects and anything else I want to
share publicly.

My dissertation, [Volcker](https://volcker.org), tests twelve traditions of
banking theory against one another on a single harmonised panel of US banking
data, under the chairmanship of Paulo dos Santos. Alongside it I work on public
finance — Treasury duration and tax-revenue cyclicality — and on the
institutional history of economics at The New School. Most of what I do involves
retrieving primary sources that are not otherwise available in machine-readable
form, and publishing them with their provenance intact.

Best wishes,

Nick
